negative_findings.description: Both the mk seed query ('банка Македонија потпиша договор нов систем плаќања') and its English equivalent returned payment-infrastructure programme news (MIPS/ISO 20022 modernisation, TIPS accession, Western Balkans interlinking) but no article naming a specific bank-vendor contract signature.
negative_findings.result_summary: Macedonian media report programme milestones and product launches; explicit 'X bank signed with vendor Y' stories are rare and must be inferred from launch coverage naming the technology partner.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must target launch/implementation vocabulary (лансира, имплементација, во соработка со, решение на) rather than contract vocabulary, or recall will be near zero.

negative_findings.description: ictactual.mk was probed as a possible MK ICT trade outlet; the search returned no article from that domain and the domain was not fetched.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: It should be re-probed directly by the liveness pass rather than dropped, since a dedicated MK ICT trade outlet would be high-value for vendor-side signals.

negative_findings.description: Kapital's web domain (kapital.mk) was inferred from the publication's known brand and its Wikipedia entry; no kapital.mk URL appeared in search results and no fetch was attempted.

negative_findings.description: This pass relied on search-engine result surfacing; individual outlet pages were not fetched, so no liveness, robots.txt, RSS-availability or paywall state was directly observed for any candidate.
negative_findings.result_summary: All access_status and blocked values are hypotheses from search metadata and publicly known outlet behaviour.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must not treat these fields as confirmed; a 403/timeout on any of them would indicate bot defence, not death.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language MK business/finance media (e.g. Portalb, Koha, Zhurnal) were not searched because the run scope fixes languages to mk and en, yet roughly a quarter of the market and several bank branch networks are covered primarily in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian-language cell or extend this one with sq queries (tender, kontratë, bankë, sistem pagesash) to avoid systematically missing deals covered only in sq.

coverage_gaps.description: State news agency MIA and broadcast economy desks (Sitel, Kanal5, Alsat) were not reached in this pass; MIA in particular carries verbatim ministry and National Bank procurement/award announcements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on mia.mk economy plus the main broadcasters' economy sections with the same keyword set.

coverage_gaps.description: No MK media archive endpoint (site search API, RSS history, or archive.org coverage depth) was identified, so retrospective reconstruction of past bank technology contracts is currently unplanned.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test per-outlet site-search URL patterns and Wayback CDX coverage for the top five outlets (bankarstvo.mk, faktor.mk, pari.com.mk, ekonomijaibiznis.mk, mkd.mk) and record working query templates.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsored/PR-native content is indistinguishable from editorial on several of these portals, and bank product-launch pieces are frequently supplied by the bank's own PR.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Tag each collected item with a PR-likelihood flag (identical wording across outlets, absence of a byline) and always corroborate vendor attribution against the vendor's own channel before treating it as a contract signal.

coverage_gaps.description: No Macedonian-language term was found in this pass that reliably distinguishes an awarded IT/payments contract from a general product launch; 'договор' alone is extremely noisy (it dominates retail framework-agreement pages such as bank T&C PDFs).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a two-token query grammar (договор/набавка/тендер AND банка/платежен/софтвер/систем) and blacklist bank self-published /media/*.pdf paths to suppress the framework-agreement noise observed in the seed query.

brief: North Macedonia has a small but genuinely differentiated Macedonian-language business-media layer: one banking vertical (bankarstvo.mk), three or four economy portals (faktor.mk, pari.com.mk, ekonomijaibiznis.mk, biznisvesti.mk, denar.mk), mainstream desks that carry central-bank payment-infrastructure news (mkd.mk, makfax.com.mk, novamakedonija.com.mk), and a strong investigative tier for procurement (Prizma/BIRN, Telma's КОД, plus the CCC watchdog's monitoring reports). Time.mk is the highest-leverage entry point because it aggregates essentially the whole outlet set into one economy stream and continually reveals new domains. Crucially, this press almost never reports contract signatures as such — it reports launches and implementations ('лансира', 'имплементација', 'во соработка со'), so vendor identity must be inferred from product coverage, which makes it a strong indirect signal channel but a weak direct one. Main structural gaps are the untouched Albanian-language media, the state agency MIA and broadcast desks, and the absence of tested archive/search endpoints for retrospective work.
